_readme: Registry of the Shoot 1 carousels. Titles and slide counts here are cross-checked against the build-ready files; the slide copy itself is only ever read from the Markdown files in content/. A carousel with blocked_reason set cannot be built or exported from the app. To unblock one later: write its build-ready file, set source_file, and remove blocked_reason here. There is deliberately no button for this in the UI.
